blocks.intro: One system or the whole path. We state where our scope ends.

items.d: No detectable chlorine or chloramine at the RO inlet, SDI ≤ 3, every season.
RO and EDI below 1.3 µS/cm at 25 °C and 500 ppb TOC.
Multi-effect and vapour compression stills making hot WFI below 0.25 EU/mL.
Double-pass RO, EDI and ultrafiltration: ambient WFI without plant steam.
Condensate at WFI limits; steam that passes EN 285 at the sterilizer.
Turbulent flow at peak draw, branches at L/D ≤ 2, sanitized by heat or ozone.
Online TOC and conductivity on the raw reading, audit trails to 21 CFR Part 11.

blocks.h: Same limits, different evidence by industry
blocks.intro: Your products set the grade; your regulator sets the evidence.

items.d: PW for oral products; WFI and pure steam for parenterals. Inspected under GUI-0001.
WFI in volume for media, buffers and every CIP final rinse.
Final rinse water worked back from the device limit of 20.0 EU per device.
The stricter of USP and Ph. Eur. on each attribute; records any client auditor follows.
Your URS becomes a functional specification, P&IDs and a risk assessment, verified at DQ.
316L to ASME BPE, orbital welds, each product-contact weld logged with its heat number.
A wet FAT to a protocol your quality unit approves, witnessed in person or remotely.
SAT on your feed water and utilities, then IQ/OQ to protocols your quality unit approved.
PQ support through 12 months of data, then service that keeps it qualified.

items.q: You are smaller than the global manufacturers. Why take the risk?
items.a: Judge us on evidence, not size: audit our quality system, witness a FAT, read a sample turnover package, call a reference. Your system’s designer answers your auditor.
No water system is. USP and Ph. Eur. set limits for water, not approvals for equipment. Compliance is water meeting the monograph at your points of use, with records.
Travel, registration and response. Your team drives to the FAT in [test bay location, city and province]; pressure parts are designed for a CRN under CSA B51.

items.q: We do not have a URS yet. Is it too early to ask?
items.a: No. Ask for a URS gap review: we return the grades, systems and qualification scope your URS should state. [Confirm: no obligation, usable in your tender]

items.q: Can our teams witness the FAT?
items.a: Yes, in person in [test bay location, city and province] or remotely; the protocol says which checks need a person on site.
